mil7.2.1:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, ghorassarassa ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabban-ti yaṃ vadesi, kataman-taṃ ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabban-ti. -
mil7.2.1:1.2: Yathā mahārāja gadrabho nāma sankārakūṭe pi catukke pi singhāṭake pi gāmadvāre pi thusarāsimhi pi yattha katthaci sayati, na sayanabahulo hoti,
mil7.2.1:1.3: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena tiṇasanthāre pi paṇṇasanthāre pi kaṭṭhamañcake pi chamāya pi yattha katthaci cammakhaṇḍaṃ pattharitvā yattha katthaci sayitabbaṃ, na sayanabahulena bhavitabbaṃ.
mil7.2.1:1.4: Idaṃ mahārāja ghorassarassa ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.2.1:1.5: Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja Bhagavatā devātidevena: Kaḷingarūpadhānā bhikkhave etarahi mama sāvakā viharanti appamattā ātāpino padhānasmin-ti.
mil7.2.1:1.6: Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja therena Sāriputtena dhammasenāpatinā pi:
